About this item

  • High-Resilience Molded Foam Seat – Won’t Flatten After 1 Year – Instead of budget foam that hardens and sags within months, the seat is built with high-density, high-resilience molded foam that bounces back day after day. It maintains its shape and cushioning far longer, preventing the “bottoming out” discomfort common at this price point
  • Adjustable Lumbar, Not a Fixed Afterthought – Unlike flimsy plastic supports that crack or lose tension, this chair features a durable lumbar mechanism that adjusts depth to match your spine’s natural curve. Genuinely relieves lower back pressure during long sitting sessions
  • Breathable Mesh Backrest – No Peeling, No Heat Buildup – Say goodbye to flaking faux leather. The high-tension mesh back promotes continuous airflow, keeping you cool in warm environments and eliminating the mess of peeling upholstery. Mesh holds up significantly better over time and looks professional years later
  • Anti-Sink BIFMA Certified Gas Cylinder – A common failure in budget chairs: the pneumatic cylinder loses pressure and slowly sinks during use. Our Class 3 BIFMA-certified gas lift is built to hold its height reliably, so your chair stays exactly where you set it—year after year. No more sudden drops or mid-work adjustments
  • Heavy-Duty Metal Core Base (330 lbs Capacity) – Thin plastic bases can crack under stress, especially near the cylinder hub. We use a reinforced nylon base with a metal core, providing the durability and peace of mind you need. Smooth-rolling, 360° silent casters glide across hardwood, tile, or carpet without scratching or catching
  • Perfectly Sized Seat for All-Day Comfort & Ideal Fit – The generously wide 19.7" seat provides ample room without feeling restrictive, while the 17.3" seat depth is carefully calibrated to support your thighs while leaving the recommended 2–4 finger gap behind your knees — protecting circulation and reducing pressure. The 17.7"–21.7" seat height range comfortably fits users from approximately 5'4" to 6'2", allowing your feet to rest flat on the floor for proper posture
  • Smarter Budget: We Invested Where It Counts – At around $150, we deliberately skipped a cheap, flimsy headrest that adds little value and focused on what matters most: an adjustable lumbar system, a metal-reinforced base, a certified gas cylinder, and a high-density seat. BIFMA basic durability/safety certification included. Comes with clear instructions for 15-minute assembly and a 2-year warranty.
  • Professional after-sales guarantee: If you encounter any of the following problems with the product you receive, please contact our after-sales customer service and we will solve them for you as soon as possible: 1. The product is missing accessories 2. The product packaging is damaged or broken 3. The chassis makes squeaking noises 4. The sitting experience is uncomfortable

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Comfortable, multi-adjustable and durable desk chair
This is an excellent desk chair, especially for long hours at the computer, but i have to confess that it's taken a little time to get used to it only because this chair and my old faux leather desk chair (also sold on amazon and pictured below for reference) are at totally different ends of the spectrum. The new VIOLET mesh computer chair is extremely comfortable even after spending most of my days and nights sitting in it since i spend many, many hours daily working, communicating and gaming on my desktop computer. the chair may appear to be lightweight; however, it's got a decent amount of weight to it because of the high quality materials used to make it, especially the solid metal parts that make up the strong and stable base. In my opinion, the ability to adjust the arm rests, seat height and lumbar support proved to be a godsend, which i was not expecting, because it all enhances the versatility and functionality of the chair. Being able to change the chair to recline a bit is probably very useful for many, but I prefer a sturdy, stiff, upright chair back, so i adjusted it accordingly at a set in place 90-degree angle. The lumbar support is especially helpful to maintain proper posture and spinal alignment, yet again there was a small issue in that i generally sit with a slight forward lean or, as stated earlier, with my shoulders directly over my hips. in order to have full back support, you must lean back slightly, and that's an awkward position for me in any chair. the arm rests can be moved down at your sides or in an upright position as if there were no arm rests at all. and i have found myself switching back and forth between the two depending on what i am doing and how much movement i require in the chair. they can also be moved forward and backward a short distance, which i did find a little bothersome when the arm rests were down and i bumped them when i happened to move my arm(s) a little. they do not lock in place, but i'm positive that this is just another little concern that i can easily get used to since the old chair's arm rests were not adjustable at all. did i mention that it's PURPLE!?! not the only reason, but definitely one of the main reasons, that i purchased this chair over every other chair i looked at. and there were a lot of them under consideration. it comes in several different colors, including the traditional, brown, white and black, among others, which i really liked a lot since my room of course has a purple theme going on, and this fashionably attractive and functional chair fits in perfectly with the decor and further brightens up the space! i am so happy with this purchase even though it took me 3 hours and not 15-20 minutes to assemble. and that was all on me because (1) i am really slow and methodical when i'm doing new things, taking care with every step to do it right, and (2) i am not handy in the least and can barely hammer in a nail these days. as advertised, all tools, primarily the allen wrench, are included. no parts were missing, and nothing was damaged upon delivery. and, best of all, i can say that i assembled it all by myself perfectly on the first try, so it was well worth the time and effort spent.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Comfortable, multi-adjustable and durable desk chair
    Reviewed in the United States on May 19, 2026
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This is an excellent desk chair, especially for long hours at the computer, but i have to confess that it's taken a little time to get used to it only because this chair and my old faux leather desk chair (also sold on amazon and pictured below for reference) are at totally different ends of the spectrum. The new VIOLET mesh computer chair is extremely comfortable even after spending most of my days and nights sitting in it since i spend many, many hours daily working, communicating and gaming on my desktop computer. the chair may appear to be lightweight; however, it's got a decent amount of weight to it because of the high quality materials used to make it, especially the solid metal parts that make up the strong and stable base.

    In my opinion, the ability to adjust the arm rests, seat height and lumbar support proved to be a godsend, which i was not expecting, because it all enhances the versatility and functionality of the chair. Being able to change the chair to recline a bit is probably very useful for many, but I prefer a sturdy, stiff, upright chair back, so i adjusted it accordingly at a set in place 90-degree angle. The lumbar support is especially helpful to maintain proper posture and spinal alignment, yet again there was a small issue in that i generally sit with a slight forward lean or, as stated earlier, with my shoulders directly over my hips. in order to have full back support, you must lean back slightly, and that's an awkward position for me in any chair.

    the arm rests can be moved down at your sides or in an upright position as if there were no arm rests at all. and i have found myself switching back and forth between the two depending on what i am doing and how much movement i require in the chair. they can also be moved forward and backward a short distance, which i did find a little bothersome when the arm rests were down and i bumped them when i happened to move my arm(s) a little. they do not lock in place, but i'm positive that this is just another little concern that i can easily get used to since the old chair's arm rests were not adjustable at all.

    did i mention that it's PURPLE!?! not the only reason, but definitely one of the main reasons, that i purchased this chair over every other chair i looked at. and there were a lot of them under consideration. it comes in several different colors, including the traditional, brown, white and black, among others, which i really liked a lot since my room of course has a purple theme going on, and this fashionably attractive and functional chair fits in perfectly with the decor and further brightens up the space!

    i am so happy with this purchase even though it took me 3 hours and not 15-20 minutes to assemble. and that was all on me because (1) i am really slow and methodical when i'm doing new things, taking care with every step to do it right, and (2) i am not handy in the least and can barely hammer in a nail these days. as advertised, all tools, primarily the allen wrench, are included. no parts were missing, and nothing was damaged upon delivery. and, best of all, i can say that i assembled it all by myself perfectly on the first try, so it was well worth the time and effort spent.

    4 out of 5 stars
    Good chair that's pretty easy to put together with 5 year warranty
    Reviewed in the United States on January 19, 2026
    Color: BlackNumber of Items: 1
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Here are my comments and concerns with model YX001 only. The instructions have a few issues imho: black letters/words printed on a dark/darker background, I literally could not read them at times and had to go to another room with a spotlight to make sure I followed directions. A box around the words are fine, but not a colored box. The 6 star gear shims (piece I) on the arms really needs a better way to identify instead of “placed in the direction of the instructions”. I am not having any issues with the arms so I assume I may have gotten it right. There aren't any instructions when to tighten all the screws that you were told to leave untightened, that could lead to an issue if when you finally get the chair finished and see step 8 saying Done and try to sit in it. Not impossible use the included Allen wrench (great it is included!) to tighten the screws from step 4 to Done because the T-handle will not fit in the now put together space. We have a bunch of regular Allen wrenches so I was able to complete the tightening required. Overall assembly was not that difficult and the time to accomplish it was not longer than expected. While the above caused some delay, the chair is still fine after 4 weeks of continuous use.

    The chair itself: the lumbar support is very nice and easy to adjust. The arms are attached to the back and the seat seemingly to give more support for them when getting in and out of the chair. The arms lifting up and away is nice. The seat, after a couple of weeks, seems reasonable, not too soft or too hard, the mesh back is nice, and the gas lift feels and sounds solid. The chair would be worth 4.5 Amazon stars, except… I’ve had a lot of office chairs (including work) over my 50+ years of sitting in front of a computer daily: cheap chairs, relatively expensive, and in between. I have a glass floor mat and the chair does not roll freely. There are flat spots on the wheels and it takes effort to get the chair to start to roll anywhere on my mat while sitting in it. The description says they are soft to reduce noise and they do on my mat. When on glass all chairs still make a noise due to the nature of the mat, so that’s not an issue. Compared to the rest of the chair the wheels aren’t up to what I expected and I am concerned about their longevity being soft with a non-circular shape. Perhaps on carpeted floors this might be hidden. Lastly, be aware the description says Lifetime Warranty, however an included index card says 5 years IF you send them an email, which I did, but was ignored for a couple weeks. Only after using Amazon to complain about them were my inquiries finally answered. It is indeed only 5 years (NOT lifetime) which is still a decent amount of years for a chair. I will update this if any issues appear within 5 years.

About this Item

  • High-Resilience Molded Foam Seat – Won’t Flatten After 1 Year – Instead of budget foam that hardens and sags within months, the seat is built with high-density, high-resilience molded foam that bounces back day after day. It maintains its shape and cushioning far longer, preventing the “bottoming out” discomfort common at this price point
  • Adjustable Lumbar, Not a Fixed Afterthought – Unlike flimsy plastic supports that crack or lose tension, this chair features a durable lumbar mechanism that adjusts depth to match your spine’s natural curve. Genuinely relieves lower back pressure during long sitting sessions
  • Breathable Mesh Backrest – No Peeling, No Heat Buildup – Say goodbye to flaking faux leather. The high-tension mesh back promotes continuous airflow, keeping you cool in warm environments and eliminating the mess of peeling upholstery. Mesh holds up significantly better over time and looks professional years later
  • Anti-Sink BIFMA Certified Gas Cylinder – A common failure in budget chairs: the pneumatic cylinder loses pressure and slowly sinks during use. Our Class 3 BIFMA-certified gas lift is built to hold its height reliably, so your chair stays exactly where you set it—year after year. No more sudden drops or mid-work adjustments
  • Heavy-Duty Metal Core Base (330 lbs Capacity) – Thin plastic bases can crack under stress, especially near the cylinder hub. We use a reinforced nylon base with a metal core, providing the durability and peace of mind you need. Smooth-rolling, 360° silent casters glide across hardwood, tile, or carpet without scratching or catching
  • Perfectly Sized Seat for All-Day Comfort & Ideal Fit – The generously wide 19.7" seat provides ample room without feeling restrictive, while the 17.3" seat depth is carefully calibrated to support your thighs while leaving the recommended 2–4 finger gap behind your knees — protecting circulation and reducing pressure. The 17.7"–21.7" seat height range comfortably fits users from approximately 5'4" to 6'2", allowing your feet to rest flat on the floor for proper posture
  • Smarter Budget: We Invested Where It Counts – At around $150, we deliberately skipped a cheap, flimsy headrest that adds little value and focused on what matters most: an adjustable lumbar system, a metal-reinforced base, a certified gas cylinder, and a high-density seat. BIFMA basic durability/safety certification included. Comes with clear instructions for 15-minute assembly and a 2-year warranty.
  • Professional after-sales guarantee: If you encounter any of the following problems with the product you receive, please contact our after-sales customer service and we will solve them for you as soon as possible: 1. The product is missing accessories 2. The product packaging is damaged or broken 3. The chassis makes squeaking noises 4. The sitting experience is uncomfortable
